validity.researcher_notes: Palo Duro Pipeline by Producers Midstream II, LLC is a real, proposed project announced June-July 2025 with binding open season for FERC-jurisdictional interstate service. Converting existing 16-inch intrastate pipeline from Nolan County (Waha, Permian Basin) to Wheeler County (Panhandle), 275 miles, to transport residue gas/NGL from Waha to markets. Verified via OGJ and company website. No updates found after October 2025 sheet date. Route geojson exists and traces north-south as stated (100.26°W-100.29°W, 35.42°N to 32.05°N). FuelSource (natural gas vs NGL residue) remains unclear from available sources - described as 'residue' market interconnect. Capacity and cost unresourced from available publicly-accessible sources (Producers Midstream website blocked WAF 403, no EIA entry, FERC/RRC databases inaccessible). Status remains proposed pending FID or public announcement of construction start.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status confirmed as 'proposed' based on most recent independent evidence (OGJ June 30, 2025; company notice June 30/July 1, 2025). Project launched binding open season in July 2025, confirming active proposal status. No updates found indicating FID, construction start, or status change through current search date (September 2026). Project is 15 months post-announcement; typical FERC conversion timelines would target construction start 6-12 months post-open-season (e.g., late 2025/early 2026). Absence of construction-start announcement suggests project may be: (a) delayed pending shipper commitments from open season, (b) waiting for FERC approval process completion, or (c) deprioritized. No cancellation announcement found. Status remains proposed; insufficient evidence to declare shelved or infer dormancy at this stage (no 2+ years elapsed post-proposal).
